palette_rationale: Preserve reviewed white body/face, gold bands and tail ornament, source eye marks and earrings from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr053 model and clips; PMDO registry supplies engine action names, events and timing fields.
ground_policy_note: Reviewed Idle and row-47 shadow. Fixed placement retains native body/tail lift; no tail-tip-based ground snapping.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own serpentine body/tail cycle; fixed root/shadow avoids snapping to swinging tail tip.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native coil-to-dive body strike around 0.35-0.45s; never ground-trim Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own raised front/release gesture; no projectile or effect asset invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own low coiled rest; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native body arch and recoiling head/tail.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own long-body/tail sweep, no synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of own body dive, one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native coil-to-rise arc; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own low braced/forward preparation and reverse-sampled recovery; no glow.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own pose motion with whole-view yaw, no duplicated endpoint.
